# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 96 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Excuse Generator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/excuse-generator/), a free online excuse generator — pick a scenario, tone and believability level to get a ready-to-send excuse from a 48-excuse library, with a plausibility meter and one-click copy, all in the browser, **Bridge Fee Comparator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/bridge-fee-compare/), a free online cross-chain bridge cost comparison — pick source and destination chains and an amount to rank six bridges by fee and speed, with a cost breakdown, demo data only, **Tiny Platformer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/tiny-platformer/), a free online platformer game — run, jump and wall-slide through 12 hand-made levels with coins, gems, timers and local best times, all in the browser, **OG Preview** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/og-preview/), a free online link card previewer — see how a URL looks on X, Slack and iMessage before posting, with per-platform character guidance and a copy-ready og:/twitter: meta tag snippet, all in the browser, **Key Inspector** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/key-inspector/), a free online keyboard event inspector — press any key to see its code, key, keyCode and modifiers, with a key history log and touch-friendly virtual keys, all in the browser, **Airdrop Checker Template** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/airdrop-checker/), a free online airdrop eligibility checker template — paste a wallet address and run it against an editable rule set with a per-rule pass/fail breakdown, demo data only, **Joke Machine** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/joke-machine/), a free online programmer joke machine — 32 jokes across four categories with punchline reveal, a groan-scale rating and session stats, all in the browser, **Stablecoin Depeg Monitor** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/depeg-monitor/), a free online stablecoin depeg monitor — simulated peg-deviation dashboard with price charts, status badges and custom alert thresholds, demo data only, **Asteroids** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/asteroids/), a free online Asteroids-style arcade game — vector-outline ship, inertia physics, splitting rocks, levels and a local high score, all in the browser, **Aspect Ratio Calc** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/aspect-ratio/), a free online aspect ratio calculator — enter one dimension to fit any ratio, with presets, a live preview box and common resolutions, all computed locally, **PX ⇄ REM Converter** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/px-rem/), a free online tool that converts pixels to rem units and back at any root font size, with a quick reference table and a copy-ready CSS snippet generator, **DAO Voting Power Viz** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/dao-voting-viz/), a free online DAO voting power visualizer — paste token holder balances to chart voting-power shares and see concentration stats (top-holder shares, Herfindahl index, Nakamoto coefficient) plus the smallest coalition that reaches a chosen passing threshold
